verdict.rationale: EFTPS lets users schedule individual tax payments up to 365 days in advance and change or cancel them, with funds settling on the selected date. That is a narrow form of scheduled work. There is no evidence of recurring schedules or general workflows, and no API; probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the only software channel is Batch Provider Software. Missing for 10: recurring/repeating schedule support, workflow automation beyond one-off payments, programmatic or API-driven scheduling, independent corroboration.
